---
title: "05 · Context construction and retrieval"
---

Which evidence should enter a model call under a context budget?

## Concepts

Trace documents from indexing through retrieval and prompt assembly. Track provenance and source versions, and distinguish retrieval recall from answer quality [@lewis2020rag].

## Study task

Given ten experiment records, select three for the proposer. Repeat with a summary and record which numbers or conditions disappear.

## Deliverable

Submit two context snapshots with source IDs, selection criteria, and one test for evidence lost during assembly.
